quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia and SoftBank Corp. agree to conduct commercial AI-RAN (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nokia agreed with SoftBank Corp. to conduct a commercial AI-RAN field trial in Japan in 2027, in a commercial network environment under commercial traffic conditions: the planned deployment will run Nokia's AI-native anyRAN Cloud RAN software on SoftBank's AITRAS platform with the NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (ARC) - an accelerated computing platform with an NVIDIA Grace CPU, NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 GPU and NVIDIA ConnectX-8 networking - together with the AITRAS Orchestrator, integrated with Nokia MantaRay. The agreement builds on the two companies' ongoing AI-RAN collaboration and, per Nokia, advances its AI-RAN commercialization roadmap from laboratory development toward real-world deployment. Chief Technology and AI Officer Pallavi Mahajan: AI-RAN 'has the potential to unlock new levels of spectral efficiency while providing the distributed intelligence needed to support physical AI.'
quarterly_data.figure: commercial AI-RAN field trial in Japan in 2027
